note: The business tax rate schedule and a single official renewal date were not confirmed; the certificate is valid for one year from issue.

items.title: Obtain and renew an Anaheim business tax certificate
items.authority: City of Anaheim Business License Office
items.description: Every business in the city needs a business license (tax certificate), which is valid for one year; the city mails a renewal notice about 30 days before it expires, but not receiving it does not excuse a late renewal. A minimum $37 processing fee applies to each initial or renewed application. Operating without a license or paying a renewal late costs a penalty of 10% or $10, whichever is greater, for each month delinquent, plus 1.5% per month.
items.deadline: Before opening, then renew before the one-year certificate expires

items.title: Renew Antioch business license
items.authority: City of Antioch Finance Department
items.description: Licenses run one year from issuance. Payment is due 30 days after the expiration date; penalties of 10% to 50% apply for later payment, and the owner must renew even without a notice.

items.title: Renew Bakersfield business tax certificate
items.authority: City of Bakersfield Finance Department, Treasury Division
items.description: The business tax certificate is valid until June 30 each year. The tax is due July 1 and must be paid before July 31 to avoid penalties; the city does not rely on courtesy reminders.

items.title: Renew Berkeley business license tax
items.authority: City of Berkeley Finance Department
items.description: Business licenses expire December 31; renewal must be filed and paid before March 1, after which a 10% penalty and 1% monthly interest apply, with a further 40% penalty from April 1.

note: The business tax is paid annually on a calendar-year basis, but no explicit due date was found.

items.title: Renew Carlsbad business license
items.authority: City of Carlsbad Finance Department, Business License Office
items.description: Under the municipal code the license tax is due annually in advance on the first day of the month the business was established; a 25% penalty applies 60 days after the due date and 50% after 90 days.
items.deadline: First day of the anniversary month

items.title: Renew Chico business license
items.authority: City of Chico Finance Department
items.description: Business licenses are renewed annually through the city's online portal; some businesses pay a flat rate and others a tax.

items.title: Renew Chula Vista business license
items.authority: City of Chula Vista Finance Department
items.description: Business licenses expire on December 31 each year and the owner is responsible for renewing; the city's recent notices set a January 31 penalty-free grace date.

items.title: Renew Clovis business tax certificate
items.authority: City of Clovis Business License Department
items.description: Business licenses run on the calendar year and expire December 31; renewal notices go out about 30 days before expiration.

note: Annual renewal is confirmed but not the date; a business license tax measure may be on the November 2026 ballot.

items.title: Renew Corona business license
items.authority: City of Corona Finance Department, Business License Division
items.description: Licenses must be renewed annually on a 12-month anniversary of the date the business first operated in Corona.
items.deadline: Anniversary of the business start date

items.title: Renew Costa Mesa business license
items.authority: City of Costa Mesa Finance Department, Business License Desk
items.description: The business license tax is an annual fee; the license lasts one year and payment is due when it expires, renewed through the city's online portal.

items.title: Renew Daly City business license
items.authority: City of Daly City Business License Division
items.description: Licenses expire September 30 and payment is due October 1; a state tax extension does not move the date, and missing income documentation can add a $250 fee.

items.title: Renew Downey business registration
items.authority: City of Downey Finance Department
items.description: Business registration renewal is due by January 31 each year; notices are mailed in early December and a missing notice does not excuse the renewal.

items.title: Renew El Monte business license
items.authority: City of El Monte Business License Division
items.description: Business tax renewals for existing businesses are due and payable at the beginning of each calendar year; penalties for noncompliance can reach 100%.

items.title: Renew Elk Grove business license
items.authority: City of Elk Grove Business License Office
items.description: The business license is valid for two years and can be renewed online.

items.title: Renew Escondido business license
items.authority: City of Escondido Business License Office
items.description: The license is valid for one year and renewed annually online; a missed renewal adds 25% per month, up to 100%.

note: Only third-party sources described a December 31 expiration; the city's own page was not confirmed.

items.title: Renew Fremont business tax certificate
items.authority: City of Fremont Finance Department, Revenue Division
items.description: Renewal is due by 5:00 p.m. on the last day of the month after the certificate's expiration date; the city sends a notice about 60 days before expiration.
items.deadline: Last day of the month after the expiration date

items.title: Renew Fresno business tax certificate
items.authority: City of Fresno Finance Department, Business Tax Division
items.description: Businesses in Fresno hold a business tax certificate. Most renew every six months and some annually; the tax is due within 30 days after each renewal period ends, with penalties after that.
items.deadline: 30 days after the end of each renewal period

items.title: Renew Fullerton business registration certificate
items.authority: City of Fullerton Business Registration Division
items.description: The certificate is issued for 12 months from the time you start business in Fullerton; renewal notices are mailed within 30 days before expiration.

items.title: Renew Garden Grove business license
items.authority: City of Garden Grove Finance Department
items.description: The license is annual and dated to the start of your business activity in the city; a renewal notice is sent about 20 days before expiration.

items.title: Renew Glendale business registration certificate
items.authority: City of Glendale Community Development, Neighborhood Services
items.description: The Business Registration Certificate must be renewed annually through the GlendalePermits portal and posted in view; renewal notices are a courtesy, not a deadline.

note: Only a third-party date (March 1) was found; a ballot measure to restructure the business license tax is on the November 3, 2026 ballot.
Third-party sources and the city's license list show anniversary-based annual terms; the city's own renewal rule was not confirmed.
No official Inglewood renewal date was found.

items.title: Renew Irvine business license
items.authority: City of Irvine Business Licensing
items.description: Licenses run for 12 months from the first day of the application month. The city mails a courtesy notice 45 days before expiration and assesses a penalty 60 days after.
items.deadline: Within 60 days after the 12-month term ends

items.title: Renew Jurupa Valley business registration
items.authority: City of Jurupa Valley Business Registration
items.description: Business registration certificates are valid for 12 months from issuance and must be renewed annually to stay in effect.

items.title: Hold a Lancaster business license
items.authority: City of Lancaster Finance Department
items.description: A business license is mandatory for anyone conducting business within city limits; renewals can be filed online.

items.title: Renew Long Beach business license
items.authority: City of Long Beach Financial Management, Business License Division
items.description: Every business operating in Long Beach needs a general business license. No renewal application is needed: the city mails an annual bill and payment by the delinquent date printed on it renews the license.
items.deadline: Delinquent date printed on the annual bill

items.title: Obtain and renew Los Angeles Business Tax Registration Certificate
items.authority: Los Angeles Office of Finance
items.description: Businesses operating in the City of Los Angeles register for the business tax and renew annually; tax is based on gross receipts and business class.

note: A December 31 renewal appears only on third-party listings; the city code confirms annual renewal.

items.title: Renew Murrieta business license
items.authority: City of Murrieta Finance Department, Business License Bureau
items.description: The license is valid for one year and due on its expiration date, which is printed on the certificate; renewal opens 90 days before expiration and late fees accrue monthly.

note: The city's business license page could not be retrieved; earlier information gave a December 31 expiration and a January 31 payment date.

items.title: Register for and renew Oakland Business Tax Certificate
items.authority: City of Oakland Finance Department, Business Tax Office
items.description: Anyone conducting business in Oakland registers and pays the annual business tax (rates vary by business class on gross receipts); certificates expire December 31.

note: No Oceanside-specific renewal rule was found.
City sources disagree on whether renewal is January 31 or tied to the start date; confirm with the License Division.

items.title: Renew Orange business license
items.authority: City of Orange Finance Department, Business License Division
items.description: Licenses renew annually on their 12-month anniversary; you have one month from expiration before a 25% late penalty applies, and a $50 fee is added at three months.
items.deadline: One month after the anniversary expiration

items.title: Renew Oxnard business tax certificate
items.authority: City of Oxnard Billing and Licensing
items.description: The tax is due in advance on the first day of the anniversary month and the certificate expires the last day of the month before it; penalties of 10% or $10 per month (maximum 50%) apply to late payment.
items.deadline: Before the first day of the anniversary month

note: Only third-party sources described the renewal (end of the quarter of issuance); the city's own page was not confirmed.

items.title: Hold a Pomona business license
items.authority: City of Pomona Finance Department, Business License Unit
items.description: A city business license is required before a business starts operating; the annual business tax schedules are published by fiscal year.

items.title: Renew Rancho Cucamonga business license
items.authority: City of Rancho Cucamonga Business Licensing Division
items.description: Renewal is annual and tied to the business's start date; the owner is responsible for renewing even without a notice.
items.deadline: Anniversary of the business start date

note: Third-party sources give conflicting due dates and the city's own renewal calendar was not found.

items.title: Renew Riverside business tax certificate
items.authority: City of Riverside Finance Department, Business Tax Office
items.description: Annual business taxes are due in advance, on or before the expiration date of the current certificate.
items.deadline: On or before the certificate's expiration date

items.title: Renew Roseville business license
items.authority: City of Roseville Finance Department
items.description: The license is good for the calendar year in which it is issued and must be renewed every January; late payments carry a penalty of 10% per month, capped at 60%.

items.title: Pay Sacramento business operations tax
items.authority: City of Sacramento Department of Finance, Revenue Division
items.description: Businesses operating in the city of Sacramento must hold a business operations tax certificate and renew it annually; apply or renew online.

items.title: Renew Salinas business license
items.authority: City of Salinas Finance Department
items.description: The tax is owed whether or not a notice arrives. Per the city, June renewals are due before the last day of August and December renewals before the last day of February.
items.deadline: Last day of the second month after expiration

items.title: Obtain and renew San Diego Business Tax Certificate
items.authority: City of San Diego Office of the City Treasurer
items.description: Every business operating in the City of San Diego, including home-based and self-employed businesses, needs a Business Tax Certificate for each business location; the annual tax depends on headcount.

items.title: Renew San Francisco Business Registration Certificate
items.authority: San Francisco Office of the Treasurer & Tax Collector
items.description: Every business operating in San Francisco must register and renew annually; fee depends on gross receipts.

items.title: File San Francisco gross receipts tax return
items.authority: San Francisco Office of the Treasurer & Tax Collector
items.description: Businesses over the small-business exemption threshold file the annual gross receipts tax return.

items.title: File San Francisco payroll expense tax return
items.authority: San Francisco Office of the Treasurer & Tax Collector
items.description: Payroll expense tax applies to businesses whose San Francisco payroll exceeds the exclusion amount.

items.title: Register for and renew San José Business Tax Certificate
items.authority: City of San José Finance Department, Business Tax Registration
items.description: Businesses operating in San José register within 90 days of starting and renew the business tax annually, due the 15th of the month the business started.
items.deadline: 15th of the month the business started

items.title: Pay San Mateo annual business tax
items.authority: City of San Mateo Finance Department
items.description: Everyone doing business in San Mateo pays an annual business tax (the business license) and receives a certificate covering the period shown on it.

note: No current official renewal date was found; older city documents point to a March filing period.

items.title: Renew Santa Clara business tax certificate
items.authority: City of Santa Clara Finance Department, Business Tax Unit
items.description: Businesses have 30 days after the renewal date to pay the business license tax; a certificate is treated as revoked if the tax is unpaid 90 days after it becomes due.

note: The city says it does not issue or require business licenses; Los Angeles County licenses may apply depending on location and activity.

items.title: Renew Santa Maria business license
items.authority: City of Santa Maria Finance Division
items.description: A license expires at the end of the 12th month after the first day the business was scheduled to open; renewals can be paid online.
items.deadline: End of the 12th month after opening

note: Only third-party sources gave a renewal date, and they disagree.
The city's pages did not state a due date; renewals are filed online or by phone.

items.title: Renew Stockton business license
items.authority: City of Stockton Revenue Services Division
items.description: Business licenses carry an annual registration tax plus a rate that depends on the activity. Renewal payment is due 30 days after the license expires; penalties accrue after that.

items.title: Renew Sunnyvale business license tax
items.authority: City of Sunnyvale Department of Finance
items.description: Business licenses renew on a two-year cycle, and the tax for both years is paid together to receive the certificate.

items.title: Renew Temecula business license
items.authority: City of Temecula Finance Department
items.description: All business licenses expire January 31; renewals received after that date incur a late penalty, and a larger one after March 1.

items.title: Renew Thousand Oaks business tax certificate
items.authority: City of Thousand Oaks Finance Department
items.description: Certificates expire December 31 and renew from January 1; the city says to renew by the last day of February and treats a certificate as delinquent after March 1.

items.title: Renew Torrance business license
items.authority: City of Torrance Finance Department
items.description: Renewals are due January 31; payments after that date carry a penalty that grows by 1% every three days up to 50%.

items.title: Renew Vacaville business license
items.authority: City of Vacaville Finance Division
items.description: Business licenses expire April 30 and a courtesy notice is mailed March 1; renewing by April 30 avoids a penalty.

note: A June 30 renewal appears only on a third-party listing; the city page (cityofvallejo.net/businesslicense) was not fully readable.

items.title: Renew Ventura business license
items.authority: City of Ventura Business Tax Office
items.description: Business licenses expire June 30 each year and renewals must be postmarked by July 31 to avoid penalties.

note: The renewal date depends on the license type and was described by third-party sources only.
City pages disagree: certificates renew by January 31 and July 31 (delinquent the next day), while another FAQ gives January 31 and June 30; a gross-receipts form is due April 30.
